name: Eagle on a Tree Trunk
material: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper
summary: Huang Shen’s swift painting style is paralleled in his calligraphy. The vertical line in running script echoes the fluid form of the eagle on a tree trunk covered with a twisted vine.
